title: The Dataverse Security Model Explained for Architects
description:
Dataverse security looks simple until business units, teams, roles and column-level rules start to interact. In this episode of M365 FM, we walk through the building blocks of the Dataverse security model and show how they combine in real solutions: environments, security roles, business units, teams and record ownership.
You will learn how to design access that is least-privilege by default, avoid role sprawl and keep the model understandable as your Power Platform estate grows.
Who it is for: Power Platform architects, solution architects, Dataverse developers and security-minded admins.
